name: Hutlar
description: Hutlar was a small, chilly world located in the Mid Rim's Senex sector. Orbiting a red dwarf star, it was the homeworld of the sentient Hutlarians. They served the aristocratic Ancient Houses of the Senex-Juvex region in various roles until 553 BBY, when their home was liberated from the nobles' control.
